summary: Verified both new builds end-to-end: (1) EXPIRING SOON backend GET /api/social/deals-expiring (cookie auth) returns Karak demo offer ofr_qa_onetime_demo for demo@bigfm.dubai with correct fields (offer_id/title/label/business_id/business_name/business_logo/expires_at future ISO), soonest-first ordering, ?within_hours clamping (1..168) honored, and returns {items:[]} for users following nothing (admin) + 401 unauthenticated. (2) Mobile Home shelf 'Expiring soon' renders home-expiring-0 with countdown 'Ends in 5h 58m' (home-expiring-0-countdown), tap routes to /offer/ofr_qa_onetime_demo. 'Near you now' row still intact — home-nearby-0 + home-nearby-0-countdown present with same copy. Countdown urgency code-verified in DealCountdown (home.tsx:55-73): urgent flag = remaining<=15min, flame icon, color #FF1E1E, flashing opacity pulse via useSharedValue+withRepeat+withTiming — correctly gated. 5/5 backend pytest green. Web home is a feed-centric layout and does NOT host these shelves (mobile-only build) which matches the review spec.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: In DealCountdown useEffect (mobile/app/(tabs)/home.tsx:61), the deps array [urgent] is missing `pulse` — harmless because useSharedValue is stable, but eslint-plugin-react-hooks will flag it.

Minor: /api/social/deals-expiring (and friends-nearby) expires_at ISO is returned without tz suffix when Motor strips tzinfo from the DB datetime; mobile DealCountdown uses new Date(iso).getTime() which treats naive strings as LOCAL time — this can misreport countdown by (device_offset) hours on devices not in UTC. Consider forcing _iso() to append 'Z' for naive UTC datetimes.
Minor: Unused styles nearbyCountdown / nearbyCountdownTxt remain in makeStyles (home.tsx:846-847) after refactor to shared DealCountdown — safe to delete.
seed_data_creation: Re-ran /app/scripts/seed_nearby_demo.py — refreshed Karak offer expires_at to +6h.
